outcome.meaning: every invariant in the spec passed and the acceptance policy was met
outcome.conclusion_reason: every rule passed; 2 row(s) were corrected on the way

second_opinions.reason: the second reading has row(s) [151, 155] differently, and with it the rule passes and no other check fails (3 failure(s) before, 0 after)

not_claimed.description: an amount altered together with every later balance, so the document remains internally exact and every value is printed on the page
not_claimed.why: the invariants check internal consistency and grounding checks presence; neither has access to the transactions that really happened

not_claimed.description: a set of transactions removed from the reading whose amounts cancel, leaving every remaining balance consistent
not_claimed.why: the checks run over the rows that were returned; nothing audits the page for rows that were never read. COUNT catches this only when the statement declares a transaction count

not_claimed.description: on a scanned page, a transcription that is internally consistent but wrong
not_claimed.why: grounding confirms a value against the evidence available for that page, which for a scan is the OCR transcription itself; without a second, independent source it is a consistency check rather than a presence check

not_claimed.description: a statement fabricated in full from a consistent ledger
not_claimed.why: only an out-of-band check against the bank can detect this
